items.title: Trump says Ukraine peace talks are progressing but defers security guarantees
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said Washington sees good prospects for a negotiated settlement and described Vladimir Putin as interested in peace. He said he was not ready to discuss potential security guarantees for Ukraine before an agreement is reached.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly receives nearly €8 billion in EU budget support
items.summary: Ukraine reportedly received nearly €8 billion in European Union budget assistance, described as the largest single disbursement under the programme. The funding comes as Kyiv continues to depend on international financial support during the war.

items.title: German-backed venture plans production of Ukrainian-designed FPV drones
items.summary: US technology company Auterion and Ukrainian manufacturer SkyFall reportedly agreed to establish a joint venture in Germany to produce Shrike attack drones. The German government is said to be considering hundreds of millions of euros in funding for production and procurement.

items.title: Reports describe missile impact and fire in Kryvyi Rih
items.summary: A Russian ballistic missile reportedly struck a building in Kryvyi Rih, with nearby restaurant windows blown out by the blast. Separate accounts reported a fire in the city and additional strikes in Kharkiv, without providing casualty figures.
